# Penguins

A short look at the `penguins` data, with $\bar{x}$ for the mean.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Here is how to write a chunk (this fence is documentation, not a chunk):

````markdown
```{r}
summary(penguins)
```
````

```{r means}
aggregate(bill_length_mm ~ species, penguins, mean)
```

```{python}
import statistics
statistics.mean([1, 2, 3])
```
